sources.title: Royal Canadian Navy — HMCS Sackville
sources.supports: 62.5 × 10.1 × 3.5 m, 965.2 tonnes, 16 kn, 4-inch, 2-pounder, two 20 mm, Hedgehog and depth charges. Basis of game dimensions and nominal fit.

sources.title: Parks Canada — Sackville National Historic Site
sources.supports: Restored 1944 exterior, radar lantern, single screw, steam machinery and ASW fittings. Conflicts with RCN on draft (4.29 m) and displacement (1,170 tons); not silently combined with RCN loading.
sources.usage: 2006 museum photograph, © none as credited on Parks Canada page. Reference only; no texture or geometry reuse.

sources.title: Canadian Naval Memorial Trust — Sackville history
sources.supports: Wartime escort service and surviving restored ship. Our generic paint pattern and interpreted superstructure are not a dated Sackville paint plan.

independence: Only original recipe, blueprint and component catalog feed the production model. No GameModels3D or other game assets used.
